WAS.source: pqec01_design.DEV_MEAN_CAND_Y / DEV_MEAN_NX_ORG, measured on MYQBD01's 14 mobile arms — the GRANDPARENT programme

NOW.source: PQEC01's own 40 Phase-A worlds, event-aligned ycells

R1_ENVIRONMENT_PROVENANCE.NOTE: round(0.961651) = 1 collapsed the candidate pool to a single trial, so the chain's effective exposure was nX alone

R2_CHAIN_CALIBRATION.MECHANISM: P(at least one birth) is CONCAVE in exposure, so predicting at the mean exposure over-predicts relative to averaging the per-world predictions (Jensen). Discarding world-level dispersion is not a presentational shortcut here -- it is what makes the model wrong, and it errs in the PERMISSIVE direction.
R2_CHAIN_CALIBRATION.CONSEQUENCE: a chain the data reject at both testable points cannot carry a quantitative candidate region. Its output is downgraded to a NECESSARY-CONDITION SCREEN: a point outside it is excluded, a point inside it is not endorsed.

R3_REGION_WITH_WORLD_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.UNIT: one world — the region is evaluated separately in EVERY Phase-A world's own measured environment, then summarized across worlds
R3_REGION_WITH_WORLD_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.GRID: 41 x 41 log points for the per-world sweep
R3_REGION_WITH_WORLD_LEVEL_UNCERTAINTY.QUANTITATIVE_BOX_IS_NOT: the published box [1.58e-05, 5.62e-04] x [1.00e-08, 1.19e-03] was computed at a single imported exposure that is 1.5011x PQEC01's own measured mean. It is withdrawn.

R4_COMPOSITION_CORRECTION.WITHDRAWN_CLAIM: 'replacing founder survival by lineage non-extinction is what dissolves the contradiction'
R4_COMPOSITION_CORRECTION.WHY_IT_WAS_WRONG: of the region's points, 88.3% ALREADY satisfy C2_FOUNDER while only 0.0% satisfy C3. The non-emptiness is therefore driven mainly by dropping C3 -- the prohibition on a separated second centre -- not by replacing the founder gate.

COUNTERFACTUAL_ON_THE_ORIGINAL_FROZEN_SE.READING: dropping C3 alone admits 1056 grid points; dropping C2_FOUNDER alone admits 225. The larger relaxation is C3.

R4_COMPOSITION_CORRECTION.WHAT_STILL_STANDS: both changes are scientifically justified and neither was chosen for its region. C3 forbids the second centre the programme exists to detect; C2_FOUNDER imposes particle identity. But the CAUSAL attribution in the C2 commit message and the audit was wrong, and is corrected here.
R4_COMPOSITION_CORRECTION.L3_TO_L7_NEVER_EVALUATED_IN_THE_REGION: the region uses only L1, L2 and the N_STAR bound. L3, L4 and L5 -- including the declared C3 replacement -- are measured at two points and enter no region computation. The region is therefore a LINEAGE-COUNT region, not a two-centre region.

L4_WAS_DEGENERATE.definition_used: P(max two-centre hold >= H_hold) with H_hold = median episode length = 16 steps
L4_WAS_DEGENERATE.why_degenerate: every world that ever reached state S held it for at least the MEDIAN episode length, so L4 returned exactly L3 at both points (0.364 and 0.409). A gate that cannot fail independently of another gate is not a gate.
L4_WAS_DEGENERATE.CORRECTED: H_hold must be a high quantile of the episode distribution, declared before evaluation. At the frozen TAU_SEP = 125 the same measurement gives 0.341 and 0.341 -- a gate that does discriminate.
L4_WAS_DEGENERATE.STATUS: L4 is WITHDRAWN as evaluated; it is handed to the successor with the quantile requirement attached

L1_AND_L2_ALSO_FAIL_AT_BOTH_POINTS.STATEMENT: the candidate report named L3's failure but did not say that L1 fails at BOTH measured points and L2 fails at B1 -- and L1 and L2 are the only gates the region actually uses. Pooled across both points, 34 of 88 worlds have a birth. This is stated now.

test_A.now: NOT_ESTABLISHED — the evidence cited contained no third-centre term at all, so it could not have settled a claim about third-centre control

ARCHITECTURE_TEST_SCORING_CORRECTED.WITHDRAWN_SENTENCE: 'none of the five tests A-E holds'
ARCHITECTURE_TEST_SCORING_CORRECTED.CORRECTED_SENTENCE: two of the five tests (A and C) are NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than false; three (B, D, E) do not hold. No test holds, so architecture change remains unjustified -- but the record must not report an open question as a settled negative.
